    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

    page_index += 1

    print(n['note_id'], n['title'])

# best-effort title match
import re
pattern = re.compile(r'Bucket\s*List\s*Simple\s*Note', re.IGNORECASE)
matched = [n for n in all_notes if pattern.search(n.get('title',''))]
print('matched_exactish', len(matched))
for n in matched:
    print('match', n['note_id'], n['title'])
